label_policy: Zero assumed-period labels. Direct VND monthly bounded salary clause with evidence; body amounts replace coarse missing-period header buckets. Exclude censored, industrial/teaching, explicit net, conflicting direct ranges and duplicate content with conflicting labels. Silver explicit evidence, not human gold. Also retain original header ranges ending in explicit VND MONTH: these are explicit units, not assumptions. Body/header explicit conflicts quarantined.
validation: New company-group split of 2025-2026 direct labels, 25 percent seed 31415. Exclude all original v1 and v2 validation/test companies from any v3 development data. Old train rows may move to new validation; never use old holdout targets for tuning.
test: New JobOKO public 2026-10-18 snapshot, MONTH bounds, independent companies unseen anywhere in v1/v2/v3 development/test; never reuse v3.0.0 single opened sample.
feature_policy: Fixed skills from requirements, explicit title seniority before generic position; mixed seniority Unknown. No salary/body/company/source/date/ID in model inputs.
selection: One fixed grid. Per-family validation MAE then RMSE; best family by same rule. No refit after selection, no test-driven loop.

promotion.rule: No auto promotion: all gates required plus serving compatibility check. If too little independent fresh data or error/market tradeoff fails, retain v2 and publish result honestly.

market_check: Freeze a panel of v2 training profiles before v3 fit; compare v2/v3 on IDENTICAL role/experience groups with n>=5 against published ITviec medians. Existing aggregate medians are a known engineering objective, not independent test truth. Do not train on aggregate rows or use for hyperparameter choice; report all groups and worse slices. Adecco 2026 separate gross range reference if compatible.
survey_2026: Downloaded official Stack Overflow 2026, verified Git LFS SHA. Only 13 plausible VN VND annual-total-compensation rows with experience after broad unit sanity. Different target and insufficient sample; not mixed into job salary labels.
limits: Small disclosed-salary sample, source selection bias, year-only Tini timestamps, imperfect company aliases, gross/net unknown where unstated. No guarantee of improvement; no Gemma fine-tune without new extraction gold labels. v3.0.0 zero-weak ablation failed known market objective, its single public sample is not reused; missing bare MONTH header support discovered by label audit, fixed before v3.1 fitting.
